title: Model quick-palette and snippet captures for Hosted API first-run flow
creator: Ava Chen
description: Capture a compact, technical-first set of screenshots and short animated GIFs that highlight the model selection palette, request-builder quick presets, and inline code snippets for the Hosted API "getting-started" flow. Deliverables should be modular (single-frame screenshots + 3 animated microflows) so docs, SDK README, and the Console tour can reuse them. Focus on clarity for developers: show model latency and token controls in the model picker, show a 3-step request builder flow (preset -> param adjustment -> preview), and include runnable code snippet variants for curl, JS SDK, and Python SDK.
acceptance_criteria: Three high-res PNGs: model-palette-compact.png, request-builder-stepper.png, snippets-grid.png
Three short GIFs (2-4s) showing: picker scroll+select, builder preset->adjust->preview, streaming response sample
All assets exported at 2x and 1x with transparent backgrounds where applicable
Figma frames reviewed and approved by PM (Priya Patel) and Eng lead (Jordan Kim)
Accompanying alt-text and short captions for docs and Console integration provided
